ITEM 1 | Spinach-like dark green leaves, flat and mostly whole, spread across the bottom and sides of a white bowl, slightly glossy with a matte-to-sheen surface, some leaves folded and some with visible stems, covering roughly 40% of the bowl's footprint | 60
ITEM 2 | Green broccoli florets, bright green to yellow-green with tight bumpy crowns and pale stems, scattered in clusters about 2-3 cm across, slightly moist, firm, sitting among the leaves on the left and lower right | 75
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-cream shaved or shredded hard cheese, thin translucent curled flakes and slivers about 2-4 cm long, dry-edged with a slightly glossy surface, piled in a loose layer over the center and left of the bowl | 35
ITEM 4 | Dark reddish-brown whole olives, smooth oval shape about 1.5-2 cm long, glossy skin, scattered among the greens in the center and right side | 25
ITEM 5 | Pale yellow-green avocado-like chunks, soft-looking pieces about 2 cm, smooth creamy surface with slight sheen, partly hidden under the cheese in the upper center | 20
ITEM 6 | Amber-golden thin dressing or oil, glistening liquid drizzled over the cheese and greens on the right side of the bowl, pooled lightly in small spots | 8
